The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `5984` (see `CouchDbBuilder.CouchDbPort`)
- Environment variable: `COUCHDB_USER=couchdb` (see `CouchDbBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `COUCHDB_PASSWORD=couchdb` (see `CouchDbBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /` to port `5984` is completed successfully.
